verses.t: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an
verses.pickthall: Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an

verses.t: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing
verses.pickthall: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing

verses.t: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return
verses.pickthall: When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return

verses.t: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record
verses.pickthall: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book

verses.t: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition
verses.pickthall: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case

verses.t: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts
verses.pickthall: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein

verses.t: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind
verses.pickthall: And the earth have We spread out, and have flung firm hills therein, and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon

verses.t: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allah]
verses.pickthall: A vision and a reminder for every penitent slave

verses.t: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
verses.pickthall: And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops

verses.t: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers
verses.pickthall: And lofty date-palms with ranged clusters

verses.t: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection
verses.pickthall: Provision (made) for men; and therewith We quicken a dead land. Even so will be the resurrection of the dead

verses.t: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud
verses.pickthall: The folk of Noah denied (the truth) before them, and (so did) the dwellers at Ar-Rass and (the tribe of) Thamud

verses.t: And 'Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot
verses.pickthall: And (the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot

verses.t: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled
verses.pickthall: And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect

verses.t: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation
verses.pickthall: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation

verses.t: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein
verses.pickthall: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein

verses.t: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left
verses.pickthall: When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left

verses.t: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record]
verses.pickthall: He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready

verses.t: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid
verses.pickthall: And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun

verses.t: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat
verses.pickthall: And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day

verses.t: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness
verses.pickthall: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness

verses.t: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp
verses.pickthall: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day

verses.t: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared
verses.pickthall: And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony)

verses.t: [Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever
verses.pickthall: (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate

verses.t: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter
verses.pickthall: Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter

verses.t: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment
verses.pickthall: Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom

verses.t: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error
verses.pickthall: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error

verses.t: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning
verses.pickthall: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning

verses.t: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants
verses.pickthall: The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed, and I am in no wise a tyrant unto the slaves

verses.t: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more
verses.pickthall: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come

verses.t: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far
verses.pickthall: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant

verses.t: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]
verses.pickthall: (And it is said): This is that which ye were promised. (It is) for every penitent and heedful one

verses.t: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance]
verses.pickthall: Who feareth the Beneficent in secret and cometh with a contrite heart

verses.t: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity
verses.pickthall: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality

verses.t: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more
verses.pickthall: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us

verses.t: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape
verses.pickthall: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)

verses.t: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind]
verses.pickthall: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence

verses.t: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness
verses.pickthall: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us

verses.t: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting
verses.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun

verses.t: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration
verses.pickthall: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations

verses.t: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near
verses.pickthall: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place

verses.t: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves]
verses.pickthall: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves)

verses.t: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
verses.pickthall: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying

verses.t: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us
verses.pickthall: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make)

verses.t: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat
verses.pickthall: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat
